_comment: Which fence languages run, and which runner each one names. The main process builds its RUNNERS table from these aliases and the renderer decides whether to draw a Run button from the same list, so a language can never run from one side and be invisible on the other. Only the aliases live here — what a runner actually spawns is code, and stays in electron/main.js. `drawn` is the other half of the same fact: the fences the app turns into a picture or a page rather than running as a process. Each drawing module reads its own name from here, and electron/ai.js reads the whole set — so the copilot is told which fences this app understands instead of being handed a list that goes stale the next time one is added.
